answer:
In 2016, the host of the longest running American game show was **Drew Carey**.

He was hosting **"The Price is Right"**, which held that distinction as the longest-running daytime game show in American television history at the time. This status was particularly notable in 2016 when the show celebrated its **10,000th episode** (which aired on February 26, 2016), with Drew Carey having taken over hosting duties from Bob Barker in 2007.
